scope: Read-only review of two function-preserving organization candidates. No source candidate, simulation, synthesis, PNR, hardware action or acceptance is created by this review.
required_contract: Original 4500 algorithm and every original weight
125 Hz control and unchanged navigation, complete telemetry, SFP Lane2 and stopping priority
Unchanged map and point capacities, precision, candidates and external results
Unchanged completion cycles; real 50 MHz and whole-chip timing still require measurement

actual_synthesis_evidence.interpretation: Synthesis groups the source sin/cos instances under u_cos but retains two physical source leaves per consumer. Source instance merging alone is not a RAM saving.

RTL_references.fact: Two ROM instances use the same SIN_INIT, independently addressed with write enable tied low.
S_LUT sets both read addresses/enables; S_LUTW is an existing wait; S_T0 latches sn/cs.
Two same-table read-only ROM instances provide simultaneous sin/cos.
S_B sets addresses/enables, S_C waits, S_D consumes sin/cos for the original four products.
Original initialized ROM branch has synchronous read and hold behavior.

alternative_implementations.intent: Keep the original simultaneous address sampling, per-port output hold and exact consumer timing.
alternative_implementations.proof_required: The C-version device must map this legal geometry to one real block per consumer, not silently duplicate storage or introduce an extra latency. Source array count does not prove mapping.

alternative_implementations.matcher_proposed_schedule: Read sine directly on S_LUT; on S_LUTW retain that response and read cosine using the unchanged da_r plus 256 modulo 1024; consume the original values on S_T0.
alternative_implementations.trajectory_proposed_schedule: Read sine from th_n on S_B; on S_C retain sine and read cosine from the already updated th (not th_n, which would add dth twice); consume the original values on S_D.
alternative_implementations.proof_required: Prove original versus proposed address/enable sampling, address stability and responses on every consume edge; account for different original inferred READ_MODE values, added hold registers, reset interruption and no-operation branches.

candidates.bit_identity: Both values are exact entries of the same immutable 1024 x 16 table. The cosine address remains (sine_address + 256) mod 1024. No trigonometric approximation or quantization is proposed.
boundaries_and_risks: Matcher and trajectory may run concurrently; each keeps its own storage. Do not share across those modules by assuming software serialization.
An earlier read introduces a different angle-to-address timing path; local and joint 50 MHz checks are mandatory.
Test every table entry, 10-bit wrap, all signed angles, reset during each fetch phase, zero points/candidates/trajectory length, and busy-time configuration changes.
No source reduction is claimed until exact output words and completion cycles match and actual ROM mapping is read back.

actual_synthesis_evidence.count_method: Within the trav_v3 module only, count primitive I<n>, S and D inputs connected exactly to rev.

RTL_references.fact: O[i][j] selects W[i][j] or W[4-i][4-j] under rev.
The center is invariant, and the eight-neighbor set is only permuted by reversal.
Nearest previously scanned row/column samples already use W directly and must remain unchanged.
T2 registers the five-point row/column and symmetric neighbor inputs; T3/T4 apply differences and gate.
T6 changes the signed baseline according to P_B for scanning-direction drop extrapolation.
The original phase transition drains 16 flush cycles before switching rev.

exact_identities: Center data is unchanged by 180-degree reversal.

Neighbor maximum step, valid count, lethal OR and valid-neighbor min/max are permutation invariant. Invalid-value internal registers need not be equal; every public output and valid write must be equal.
For any signed 16-bit heights, difference is in [-65535,65535]. Thus gate(-d,jump) = -gate(d,jump) with no signed-overflow exception.
Reversing five heights reverses and negates their four adjacent differences; hence sx_world = rev ? -sx_scan : sx_scan, and the same identity holds for y.
Original (P_B ? sx_world : -sx_world) equals -sx_scan in both scan directions. Absolute rise and roughness remain unchanged.
cfg_jump is 8 bits; each gated difference lies in [-255,255], so each four-term sum lies in [-1020,1020] and is exact in the existing 19-bit path.

resource_prediction.expected_change: Remove part of the data-direction muxing and its rev fanout; keep all windows, caches, four passes and exact arithmetic.

boundaries_and_risks: Keep actual address reversal and scanning-direction predecessor selection; only eliminate redundant data permutation.
Do not drop the sign compensation in the slope/drop calculation.

Compare all elevation writes, cost-map writes, bitmap writes, busy and done cycle by cycle for forward/reverse scans, invalid cells, fill thresholds, signed extremes, high-only steps, boundaries, reset/clear and busy-time configuration changes.
Retain phase flushing and prove no old-window values enter a new scan phase.
241 direct inputs describe a real high-fanout connection, not a list of failed routing nets or a proven congestion root cause.

csum_scope_correction.earlier_statement: The trajectory csum width had already been reduced automatically to 16 bits.
csum_scope_correction.cause: An unscoped search found a different module's 16-bit csum.
csum_scope_correction.mathematical_bound: T is 8 bits and a summed known cost is at most 254, so csum <= 255*254 = 64770. A future 16-bit explicit width candidate is plausible but is unimplemented and has no measured resource/timing benefit.
